name: Hy3
short: Tencent's Jul 2026 open-weight 295B/21B-active MoE (Apache 2.0, 256K): SWE-bench Verified 78.0%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 71.7%, GPQA 90.4% at ~$0.08/$0.33 - not on Zen.
pricingNote: $0.0825/$0.33 off-peak (Tencent fp8), $0.14/$0.58 on other hosts, $0 on the TokenHub plan
pricingTiers: Tencent fp8 $0.0825/$0.33 per 1M off-peak (00:00-16:00 UTC); $0.14/$0.58 on other hosts
standout: Tencent’s budget open-weights coder: strong science-question scores at some of the lowest serving costs around.
tradeoff: Text-only and mid-tier on terminal tasks — breadth lives in the bigger Hy generations; the earlier hy3-preview carried a custom licence.
